title: Work
description: JSON Schema for a work instance: an episode of doing with a defined output, classified by work-type into one of the four corners (process, procedure, derivation, inquiry).

has-output.description: What the work produces — the individuating predication.

work-type.description: Which of the four closure-position corners this work occupies.

organized-by.description: Reference to the task that contains this work.

required-skill.description: Slug of the skill a dispatch candidate must advertise.
